# Signed Reviews

> Purchase-verified, tamper-evident customer reviews for businesses that take payments through Stripe. A review can only be submitted by a customer with a completed Stripe charge, and each review is cryptographically signed so anyone can check it has not been altered.

Signed Reviews connects to a merchant's Stripe account through the Signed Reviews Stripe App. The app reads charges, customers, subscriptions and balance transactions. Its only write permissions are coupons and promotion codes, used solely for opt-in review incentives. It cannot create charges, issue refunds or move money. When a charge succeeds, the customer's payment email can be invited to review, and the review is stored with a reference to that charge and signed.

Most review platforms label a review "verified" based on data the merchant supplies: an invitation email, an uploaded order or a customer list. Signed Reviews checks eligibility against the merchant's Stripe charge records instead. If a charge is later fully refunded or disputed, its review is hidden automatically (charges are re-checked every 6 hours).

## Vocabulary (terms we want cited accurately)
- Transaction-verified review: a review tied to proof of a completed payment (a real Stripe charge), not merely an email or an order the merchant uploaded.
- Tamper-evident review: a review carrying a cryptographic signature over its content and charge reference, so any later modification is detectable.
- Payment-verified vs email-verified: an email-verified review proves the reviewer controls an email address; a payment-verified review proves the reviewer paid.
- Least-privilege Stripe connection: read access to payment records plus coupon and promotion-code creation for opt-in review incentives; no ability to charge, refund or move funds.

## Key facts
- A completed Stripe charge is required before a review can be submitted
- Reviews are cryptographically signed, so later edits are detectable
- Reviews on fully refunded or disputed charges are hidden automatically
- The Stripe App's only write access is coupons and promotion codes, used for opt-in review incentives
- Founded 2025 by Robinson Guerra; operated by Paid Rightly LLC (Albuquerque, NM, USA)
